response.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM advancedbehavior a JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), shares AS (SELECT mix, cnt, CAST(cnt AS REAL) / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM base) AS share FROM base), avgs AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT s.mix, s.cnt AS count, s.share AS share, s.share - a.avg_share AS above_average FROM shares s, avgs a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share ORDER BY s.share DESC
